source: ## S2 当前数值实现与物性换算
english: ## S2 Current implementation and physical-unit conversion

source: [当前D2源码](/home/dell/yuanyuanxu/SIM240/CASE/D_series/D2_groove_error_map/src/d2_groove_error_map.cpp)给出D3Q19_FORCE、ForcedBGK、τ=1、Lx=Ly=240 nm、均匀加速度a=10⁵ m/s²。先设ρ=1000 kg/m³和ν=10⁻⁶ m²/s，由μ=ρν得1 mPa·s。物性固定后，dt=(τ−1/2)dx²/(3ν)，因此dx=5/2.5 nm分别对应dt约4.1667e−12/1.0417e−12 s。两个μ=15 mPa·s工况与主地图分列。
english: The [current D2 source](/home/dell/yuanyuanxu/SIM240/CASE/D_series/D2_groove_error_map/src/d2_groove_error_map.cpp) specifies D3Q19_FORCE, ForcedBGK, τ=1, Lx=Ly=240 nm and uniform acceleration a=10⁵ m/s². Density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and kinematic viscosity ν=10⁻⁶ m²/s give μ=ρν=1 mPa·s. With physical properties fixed, dt=(τ−1/2)dx²/(3ν). Thus dx=5/2.5 nm corresponds to dt≈4.1667e−12/1.0417e−12 s. Two μ=15 mPa·s cases are separate from the main map.

source: 当前OpenLB的[ForcedBGK定义](/home/dell/openlb/src/dynamics/dynamics.h:224)使用PlainGuo；[computeU实现](/home/dell/openlb/src/dynamics/momenta/elements.h:1601)加入FORCE/2。当前Makefile与源树是实现证据，不自动绑定每一历史二进制，来源限制见S10。

The current Makefile and source tree are implementation evidence, but do not automatically bind every historical binary. See S10.

source: ## S4 停止条件与统计
english: ## S4 Stopping criteria and statistics

source: D2采用最后1000条主通量样本，计算样本标准差除以均值绝对值、极差除以均值绝对值，以及交叉通量绝对峰值。停止阈值分别为10⁻⁶、5×10⁻⁶与10⁻¹² m²/s。D3斜向存在真实交叉通量，按该算例自己的统计判据处理，不混用主轴绝对交叉通量条件。
english: D2 uses the final 1000 main-flux samples to calculate sample standard deviation divided by absolute mean, range divided by absolute mean, and the absolute peak cross-flux. Thresholds are 10⁻⁶, 5×10⁻⁶ and 10⁻¹² m²/s, respectively. D3 oblique flow has physical cross-flux and uses its own statistical criteria; the principal-axis absolute cross-flux rule is not transferred to it.

source: 36点末窗独立复算见[Methods_followup_relstd_20261022.json](/home/dell/yuanyuanxu/SIM240/docs/reports/Methods_followup_relstd_20261022.json)。以m=1−rel_std/10⁻⁶定义相对余量，27点不足1%、9点不足0.1%。这是已执行的指定统计核对；停止条件本身不是空间精度或完整物理验收证明。
english: Independent final-window recomputation for 36 samples is in [Methods_followup_relstd_20261022.json](/home/dell/yuanyuanxu/SIM240/docs/reports/Methods_followup_relstd_20261022.json). With relative margin m=1−rel_std/10⁻⁶, 27 samples have margins below 1% and 9 below 0.1%. This is the specified statistical check already performed. Stopping criteria are not proof of spatial accuracy or complete physical acceptance.

source: ## S5 通量、输运系数与参考高度
english: ## S5 Flux, transport coefficient and reference height

source: 对流体核心节点累加物理速度乘dx³，再除平面面积A_plan，得到J，单位m²/s；K=μJ/(ρa)，单位m³。等宽槽/凸台的体积等效高度为H_ref=h+d/2，故J=H_ref〈u〉_Ω，通常渗透率κ=K/H_ref，单位m²。
english: Summing physical velocity times dx³ over fluid core nodes and dividing by plan area A_plan gives J in m²/s. Then K=μJ/(ρa), in m³. For equal-width grooves and ribs, the equivalent-volume height is H_ref=h+d/2; hence J=H_ref〈u〉_Ω and conventional permeability κ=K/H_ref, in m².

source: 表S1保留原始K与结果路径。较旧结果未逐项打印全部物性字段时，可利用记录的τ、dx、dt检查ν的转换一致性，但不能把这种反算当成缺失的历史源码或构建证明。
english: Table S1 retains original K and result paths. If older results do not print all physical-property fields, recorded τ, dx and dt can check consistency of the ν conversion. Such reverse calculation does not establish missing historical source or build provenance.

source: ## S6 局部立方律的一维平均关系
english: ## S6 One-dimensional averaging in the local cubic law

source: 正文文献[4] Patir–Cheng 1978印刷第15页式（23）、（24），分别给出横向调和平均与纵向算术平均流量因子。为避免原文归一化高度与本稿残余间隙混同，以h0表示归一化高度、H表示局部总间隙。乘回h0³/12后，关系为K_parallel=〈H³〉/12，K_perp=1/(12〈H⁻³〉)。H=h与h+d各占一半，即得正文式（3）；d=0时两式均退化为h³/12。
english: Reference [4], Patir–Cheng (1978), printed page 15, Eqs. (23) and (24), gives transverse harmonic and longitudinal arithmetic averages of flow factors. To distinguish its normalization height from the present residual gap, write h0 for the former and H for local total height. Multiplying back by h0³/12 gives K_parallel=〈H³〉/12 and K_perp=1/(12〈H⁻³〉). Taking H=h and h+d over equal widths yields manuscript Eq. (3); d=0 recovers h³/12 in both directions.

source: 指定原文页已在2026-10-22至23日核对中渲染目视检查，记录见[原文核对报告](/home/dell/yuanyuanxu/SIM240/docs/reports/Methods_support_audit_20261022/REPORT.md)。此关系成立于所用Reynolds局部模型内，不证明显式台阶流动或唯一耗散机制。第三方论文全文未复制进本补充材料目录。
english: The specified original pages were rendered and visually checked during the 2026-10-22 to 23 audit; see the [source-check report](/home/dell/yuanyuanxu/SIM240/docs/reports/Methods_support_audit_20261022/REPORT.md). This relation holds within the local Reynolds model. It does not establish the exact resolved step flow or a unique dissipation mechanism. Third-party full texts were not copied into this supplementary directory.

english: Frozen conditions in the [periodic-domain protocol](/home/dell/yuanyuanxu/SIM240/CASE/03_grid_convergence/G4_EX240_period_convergence/PERIOD_CONVERGENCE_PROTOCOL.md) are h=75 nm, d=100 nm and dx=2.5 nm. source: 这些证据支持该基准几何在所检力范围内的线性响应和周期复制数值一致性，不表示全部36个5 nm样点各自做过多力检查，也不是物理RVE收敛证明。编号工作没有重做全部原数值门禁或人工质量轨迹放行。
english: These results support linear response over the checked force range and numerical consistency of periodic replication at this reference geometry. They neither establish individual multi-force checks for all 36 main-map samples at 5 nm nor prove physical RVE convergence. Supplementary numbering did not repeat all original numerical gates or manual mass-trajectory acceptance.

The flat-wall gap is 75 nm; the groove reference has $h=75$ nm, $d=100$ nm, period 240 nm and width 120 nm. The original properties are $\rho=1000$ kg/m³, $\mu=1$ mPa·s, $a=10^5$ m/s² and $\tau=1$. The [original protocol](/home/dell/yuanyuanxu/SIM240/CASE/03_grid_convergence/G2_EX240_grid_convergence/STEP3_PROTOCOL.md) contains the complete geometry and parameters. K is in m³. Each eta is directional K divided by same-grid flat-wall K; anisotropy is along-groove K divided by across-groove K. Both are dimensionless. The method follows manuscript reference [10]; original-version checks are bounded in S11.

source: 令$\phi_1$、$\phi_2$分别为细格和中格结果，采用统一符号定义外推值$\phi_{\mathrm{ext}}=\phi_1+(\phi_1-\phi_2)/(r^p-1)$，$e_a=|(\phi_1-\phi_2)/\phi_1|$，$e_{\mathrm{ext}}=|(\phi_{\mathrm{ext}}-\phi_1)/\phi_{\mathrm{ext}}|$，$GCI_{\mathrm{fine}}=F_s e_a/(r^p-1)$。表中误差与GCI列均以百分数报告；CSV保留原始三格值与完整精度。
english: Let $\phi_1$ and $\phi_2$ denote the fine and medium results. Using common notation, define extrapolation $\phi_{\mathrm{ext}}=\phi_1+(\phi_1-\phi_2)/(r^p-1)$, $e_a=|(\phi_1-\phi_2)/\phi_1|$, $e_{\mathrm{ext}}=|(\phi_{\mathrm{ext}}-\phi_1)/\phi_{\mathrm{ext}}|$ and $GCI_{\mathrm{fine}}=F_s e_a/(r^p-1)$. Error and GCI columns are percentages; the CSV retains original three-grid values and full precision.

source: **失败记录随表披露：** 历史1.25 nm横槽运行相对质量指标为$1.1967043900362632\times10^{-10}$，超过冻结阈值$10^{-10}$，独立退出码3。K_perpendicular、eta_perpendicular与anisotropy均依赖该失败点。可计算的GCI不赋予该记录合格参考资格，不改变历史G2 Step 3的FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE判定。所列估计不外推其他几何，也不构成全参数域严格误差界。
english: **Failure disclosed with the estimates:** the historical 1.25 nm transverse relative mass metric is $1.1967043900362632\times10^{-10}$, above frozen threshold $10^{-10}$, with independent exit code 3. K_perpendicular, eta_perpendicular and anisotropy all depend on that failed record. Calculable GCI does not qualify it as an accepted reference or change the historical G2 Step 3 FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE. These estimates neither extend to other geometries nor establish strict full-domain error bounds.

source: 沿槽与横槽观测阶分别为1.513和1.256。观测阶低于形式阶本身不足以判定计算不合格，也不能确认渐近性。使用同组三点拟合p后，归档相邻GCI比化为细中结果之比，因此历史“asymptotic range confirmed”标签不作为独立渐近区证据。所报GCI为该三格链的条件性估计。
english: Along-groove and across-groove observed orders are 1.513 and 1.256. An order below the formal order alone establishes neither failure nor an asymptotic range. Once p is fitted from the same three values, the archived adjacent-GCI ratio reduces to the fine/medium result ratio. The historical “asymptotic range confirmed” label is therefore not independent asymptotic-range evidence. Reported GCI values remain conditional estimates for this three-grid chain.

source: 对同一平板基准，细格积分K相对解析值的偏差为0.0271569%。将解析偏差与GCI统一以细格值归一，二者分别为0.0271495%与0.0352348%，估计幅度约为解析偏差的1.298倍。该比较仅支持此平板配置和积分量，不证明沟槽或其他几何具有相同的误差覆盖。
english: For the same flat-wall benchmark, fine-grid integrated K differs from the analytical value by 0.0271569%. Normalizing both the analytical discrepancy and GCI by the fine-grid value gives 0.0271495% and 0.0352348%, respectively, a ratio of approximately 1.298. This supports only that planar configuration and integrated quantity; it does not establish comparable coverage for grooves or other geometries.

source: 2026-10-28更新[6]；其余条目沿用各自核对日期，文献编号沿用配套正文。以下是来源核对范围，不是对本项目精度的统一放行：
english: Reference [6] was updated on 2026-10-28; other entries retain their individual check dates. Numbers follow the companion manuscript. These are source-check scopes, rather than a blanket release of project accuracy:

source:
- **[4] Patir–Cheng**：现有合法本地全文的印刷第15页式（23）（24）已再次目视核对，支持一维Reynolds模型内的调和/算术平均关系。不能据此将局部模型视为显式台阶域精确解或唯一耗散机制。
- **[5] Dewangan–Datta 2020**：本次另收到JFM891、A12、DOI10.1017/jfm.2020.134的35页PDF，已核首页题名、作者和摘要身份；与下载目录原有副本SHA完全相同。本轮未新增全文理论适用性裁定。它既非[8]Bouzidi，也非[6]的2018年论文，不能替代这两篇各自的原文依据。
- **[6] Dewangan–Datta 2018**：正式题名为 *Flow through microchannels with topographically patterned wall: A spectral theory for arbitrary groove depths*，European Journal of Mechanics–B/Fluids 70，73–84，DOI 10.1016/j.euromechflu.2018.02.004。2026-10-28收到完整接收稿（1页出版社封面及稿内1—34页），身份与本轮Crossref登记一致。实读稿内4—8、11—13、21—24及29页：主问题为一面正弦壁、一面平壁、全充液、定常不可压牛顿流体的充分发展沿槽流动，式（1）（2）采用黏性—压力平衡及两壁无滑移；完整谱方法不以小振幅为前提，小振幅、厚/薄通道及滑移的渐近结果分别受其展开条件约束。原文的h是周期平均高度、a是正弦振幅，不能直接当作本文残余间隙h和矩形槽深d；Q/Q0为相对于相同平均高度平通道的无量纲流量比，不直接等同本文以m³计的K。稿内22页讨论非光滑矩形槽可能失去指数谱收敛，24页将跨槽流动列为未来工作；不得据该文给本文矩形槽P/T或全图精度背书。上述指定适用条件在接收稿层面已核；最终排版版与该稿尚未逐页对应，未重新验证原文算例或审定严格误差界，详见[本次接收报告](../Dewangan2018_received_20261028/REPORT.md)。
- **[7] OpenLB**：Crossref核得2021年、81卷258–288页，[软件官方目录](https://www.openlb.net/articles/)可定位同一DOI；官网旧目录使用2020年条目，按最终卷页采用2021年。软件论文身份不证明各历史运行使用了哪个OpenLB版本。
- **[8] Bouzidi**：2026-10-27新增接收用户下载的PoF13(11)、3452–3459发表版，DOI10.1063/1.1399290；PDF共9页，含1页出版社封面及8页连续正文。已目视核身份和页码，实读3453页的q/碰撞传播定义及3454页图1、固定壁面线性插值式（5a）（5b）、式（7）与静止壁适用说明；与当前D2及OpenLB源码逐项核对q、两分支、时间层、零壁速及q=.5。传播后数组读取与原文碰撞后取值对应；原文将q=.5归入后一分支、代码归入前一分支，两式在该点代数一致。指定六项原文—所查当前实现对应已核，源码行/SHA、原件与范围见[本次Bouzidi接收报告](../Bouzidi_P8_received_20261027/REPORT.md)。该结论限有效壁面链、有限输入及所查正常传播路径，不核定运行时回退或历史二进制来源，不据方法文献保证任意壁距/阶梯几何的二阶精度、零边界误差或严格误差界。
- **[9] Guo**：2026-10-27新增接收用户下载的PRE65(4)、046308六页发表版，DOI10.1103/PhysRevE.65.046308；实读046308-1—3的力密度定义及式（15）、（17）、（19）、（20），末页身份/连续页码另核。原文F=ρg，与项目FORCE字段的格子加速度区分；当前`PlainGuo`/通用`addExternalForce`使用ρ_lat乘加速度及(1−omega/2)，`ForcedMomentum::computeU`加入FORCE/2，对应原文力项与半步速度定义。指定内容、源码行与SHA见[本次原文接收报告](../Primary_text_received_20261027/REPORT.md)。此项只关闭所查原文—当前实现关系，不证明所有历史二进制的构建来源或数值精度。
- **[10] GCI**：2026-10-27新增接收用户下载的2008年JFE130(7)、078001四页发表版，DOI10.1115/1.2960953；实读078001-1—4。末页六作者身份与既有四作者ASME方法文稿分开记录；已核三网格与网格比说明、步骤3—5/式（3）—（7）及迭代误差附录式（A1）—（A3）的指定版本对应。发表版式（4）外推量上标为21，式（6）内部仍写12，与文稿同样保留符号不一致；表S5采用统一符号并另行定义。原文版本缺口在上述指定范围内关闭，证据见[本次原文接收报告](../Primary_text_received_20261027/REPORT.md)。方法依据不使历史质量FAIL转为通过，不证明迭代误差已获充分控制，也不建立全图严格误差界。
english:
- **[4] Patir–Cheng:** Eqs. (23) and (24) on printed page 15 of the available lawful local full text were visually rechecked. They support harmonic/arithmetic averages within the one-dimensional Reynolds model, not an exact resolved step-domain solution or a unique dissipation mechanism.
- **[5] Dewangan–Datta 2020:** a 35-page PDF of JFM 891, A12, DOI 10.1017/jfm.2020.134 was received and its first-page title, authors and abstract identity checked. Its SHA matches the prior download exactly. No new full-text theoretical-applicability adjudication was performed. It is neither [8] Bouzidi nor the 2018 paper [6], and cannot replace either original source.
- **[6] Dewangan–Datta 2018:** the title is *Flow through microchannels with topographically patterned wall: A spectral theory for arbitrary groove depths*, European Journal of Mechanics–B/Fluids 70, 73–84, DOI 10.1016/j.euromechflu.2018.02.004. On 2026-10-28 the complete accepted manuscript was received, comprising 1 publisher cover page and manuscript pages 1–34, with identity matching Crossref. Manuscript pages 4–8, 11–13, 21–24 and 29 were read. The main problem is fully developed, steady, incompressible Newtonian along-groove flow between a sinusoidal wall and a flat wall. Eqs. (1) and (2) use viscous–pressure balance and no slip at both walls. The full spectral method does not require small amplitude; small-amplitude, thick/thin-channel and slip asymptotics have separate limiting assumptions. Its h is period-mean height and a is sinusoidal amplitude, not the present residual gap h and rectangular depth d. Q/Q0 is dimensionless flow relative to a planar channel of the same mean height, rather than K in m³. Page 22 discusses possible loss of exponential spectral convergence for nonsmooth rectangular grooves; page 24 lists transverse flow as future work. It does not certify present rectangular-groove P/T or map-wide accuracy. These specified applicability conditions were checked at accepted-manuscript level. The journal version has not been matched page by page; original examples were not reverified and strict error bounds were not certified. See the [receipt report](../Dewangan2018_received_20261028/REPORT.md).
- **[7] OpenLB:** Crossref identifies 2021, volume 81, pages 258–288; the [official software bibliography](https://www.openlb.net/articles/) locates the same DOI. Its older list uses 2020, whereas the final volume/pages are cited as 2021. Software-paper identity does not establish the version used by historical runs.
- **[8] Bouzidi:** on 2026-10-27 the user-supplied published PoF 13(11), 3452–3459, DOI 10.1063/1.1399290, was received. The 9-page PDF has 1 cover page and 8 consecutive article pages. Identity and pagination were visually checked. The q/collision/streaming definitions on 3453, Figure 1 on 3454, stationary-wall linear formulas (5a)/(5b), Eq. (7) and stationary-wall applicability were read and compared with current D2/OpenLB q, branches, time levels, zero wall velocity and q=.5. Post-streaming array reads correspond to post-collision values in the paper. The paper assigns q=.5 to the later branch, while the implementation assigns it to the earlier branch; both expressions agree algebraically there. The six specified correspondences were checked for the inspected implementation; see [the receipt](../Bouzidi_P8_received_20261027/REPORT.md) for source lines/SHA, original and scope. This applies to valid wall links, finite inputs and the inspected normal streaming path. It does not qualify runtime fallbacks, historical binaries, arbitrary wall-distance/step second-order accuracy, zero boundary error or strict error bounds.
- **[9] Guo:** on 2026-10-27 the published PRE 65(4), 046308 six-page original, DOI 10.1103/PhysRevE.65.046308, was received. Pages 046308-1–3 were read for force density and Eqs. (15), (17), (19) and (20); last-page identity and continuity were checked separately. Paper force density F=ρg differs from lattice acceleration in FORCE. Current `PlainGuo`/`addExternalForce` uses ρ_lat times acceleration and (1−omega/2); `ForcedMomentum::computeU` adds FORCE/2, corresponding to the force term and half-step velocity. Scope, lines and SHA are in [the original-source receipt](../Primary_text_received_20261027/REPORT.md). This closes only the specified current implementation correspondence, not historical-build provenance or numerical accuracy.
- **[10] GCI:** on 2026-10-27 the published 2008 JFE 130(7), 078001 four-page original, DOI 10.1115/1.2960953, was received and pages 078001-1–4 read. Its six last-page authors are recorded separately from the existing four-author ASME methods manuscript. Specified checks covered three grids and refinement ratios, steps 3–5/Eqs. (3)–(7), and iterative-error appendix Eqs. (A1)–(A3). In the published version, Eq. (4) uses superscript 21 while Eq. (6) still uses 12 internally, retaining the manuscript’s notation inconsistency; Table S5 defines unified notation separately. The version gap is closed within that scope; see [the source receipt](../Primary_text_received_20261027/REPORT.md). Method provenance does not turn historical mass FAIL into PASS, establish adequate iterative-error control or provide strict map-wide error bounds.
